description: The newest published nightly-next DMG as people run it (stories/shipped_nightly.py): the DMG verified first (verify-dmg-artifact.sh: stapled tickets, Gatekeeper, cmux NEXT identity; codesign --deep --strict on the installed copy), then from always-on signals only, never a debug.* request: cold (purged) and warm launch marks (launch.mark signposts), 60 s idle wakeups and CPU with 10 Chromium tabs read at the window's ends, footprint, and action.perform / action.commit of newTab, closeTab, splitRight, closeTab rounds. Results carry the DMG's own CMUXCommit and config release.
not_measurable: run_story.py measures only the bench and bench-checks artifact of the scheduled --sha (CONFIGS), and the scheduler requests a build for every story's (sha, config); this story builds nothing and measures the published nightly-next DMG at its own commit, so it needs a daily scheduler lane with no build request
